steps.say: Bus A leaves Malang at 07:10 and reaches Surabaya at 08:50.
First count on to the next o'clock.
Then count on to the arrival time and add the parts.

check.prompt: Rafi gets to Lawang at 08:00. Which bus can Rafi catch to Surabaya?

options.why: Bus B leaves Lawang at 09:05, after Rafi arrives.
Bus A leaves Lawang at 07:35, before Rafi arrives.

hints: A bus that has already left cannot be caught.
check.explanation: Bus A has already left Lawang at 07:35. Bus B leaves Lawang at 09:05, so Rafi can catch Bus B.
